verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official CLI with extensive first-party documentation. The docs cover interactive terminal use, headless print mode, the one-line install, and machine-readable json/stream-json output with non-zero exit codes. They also document ACP over stdio JSON-RPC, least-privilege permission tokens, GitHub Actions recipes, and API-key and service-account auth for CI. A probe confirms the CLI is documented at cursor.com/cli. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI working as documented.
